AGRICULTURE — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #18
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preserving Crop Products? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preserving Crop Products.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Preserving Crop Products.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preserving Crop Products.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preserving Crop Products.

2. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Burning crop residue every week

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Rearing Small Domestic Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Rearing Small Domestic Animals.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Rearing Small Domestic Animals.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Rearing Small Domestic Animals.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Rearing Small Domestic Animals.

   B. 50 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 0 °C

6. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water always increases oxygen

7. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. Heating until a solid melts

8. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Controlling Soil Erosion? (1 mark)

   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Producers
   D. Primary consumers only

12. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. joule (J)
   D. newton (N)

13. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Milk souring
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Ice melting to water
